Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.util

Class CachingHttpServletRequest

java.lang.Object
jakarta.servlet.ServletRequestWrapper
jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequestWrapper
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.util.CachingHttpServletRequest
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest, jakarta.servlet.ServletRequest
public class CachingHttpServletRequest extends jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequestWrapper
Wraps an HttpServletRequest and tees a bounded copy of the request body into memory for debug logging.

Unlike a fully-buffering wrapper, this captures at most a configured cap (default 8 KB) of the body while passing the full stream through to the handler untouched. The total number of bytes read is tracked so a truncation marker can be rendered. Memory stays bounded even for large uploads.

    • getReader

      public BufferedReader getReader() throws IOException
      Returns a character-stream tee over the same underlying byte stream captured by getInputStream().

      A handler that reads the request body through getReader() instead of getInputStream() would otherwise bypass capture entirely — the default ServletRequestWrapper.getReader() delegates straight to the wrapped request. This override routes the reader through the tee'd stream so both access styles are captured identically.
